summary: Tested the auto-update / manual refresh mechanism (backend + frontend) plus quick backend regression. All 7 pytest tests passed (94s). Full ingestion cycle verified: POST /api/admin/ingest is non-blocking (<10s response), guard prevents concurrent ingestions (2nd call returns started:false / raison:deja_en_cours), /api/status exposes synchronisation_en_cours (bool) + frequence ('...toutes les 2 heures'), and derniere_synchro.last_sync gets updated after completion. Frontend Home page: sync-status-bar, last-sync-label ('il y a 1 min') and btn-refresh visible; clicking Actualiser triggers POST /api/admin/ingest, disables button, shows spinner (animate-spin), toast appears, matches grid renders correctly, no error overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~450 lines with many responsibilities (endpoints + startup + scheduler + helpers); consider splitting into routers/services for maintainability.
ingest_state guard is in-memory only; if multiple workers were ever run, concurrency guard would not hold. Acceptable for single-worker uvicorn but worth noting.
Home.jsx refresh() polling stops after 40 tries (200s) but keeps refreshing state accurate; consider also displaying error toast if tries > 40 to avoid silent failure.
seed_data_creation: None; used real synced DB data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sync mechanism (auto every 2h + manual refresh + guard) works end-to-end. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_sync.py can be reused. Full sync round-trip takes ~90s in tests.
